title: Happy goldfish
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='body' cx='40%' cy='40%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffb300'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f57c00'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='tail' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffca28'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff8f00'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <path d='M78 50 Q92 32 96 40 Q90 50 96 60 Q92 68 78 50 Z' fill='url(#tail)' stroke='#ffd54f' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- dorsal fin -->
  <path d='M45 32 Q52 18 62 26 Q58 34 55 38 Z' fill='#ffca28' stroke='#ffd54f' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- pectoral fin -->
  <path d='M52 62 Q58 76 46 74 Q44 66 48 62 Z' fill='#ffca28' stroke='#ffd54f' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='50' rx='30' ry='21' fill='url(#body)' stroke='#ffd54f' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='58' rx='18' ry='9' fill='#ffe9a8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- gill line -->
  <path d='M62 36 Q58 50 62 64' fill='none' stroke='#f57c00' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='44' r='8' fill='#fff8e1'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='44' r='4.5' fill='#3b2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='28.5' cy='42.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M22 55 Q27 62 34 58' fill='none' stroke='#c75b00' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='57' r='3' fill='#ff9e7a' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- bubbles -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='30' r='3.5' fill='none' stroke='#9be7ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='20' r='2.5' fill='none' stroke='#9be7ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='21' cy='16' r='2' fill='none' stroke='#9be7ff' stroke-width='1.8'/>
</svg>
